router.task: Assess vendor security before signing the contract
Our line managers are pushing back hard on the new agent workflow. How do we handle the resistance before go-live?
The pilot hit its numbers but the CFO wants proof before we fund the enterprise rollout. What does the business case need to show?
Who owns the claims process end to end once the agent handles intake, and where does the handoff sit?
We have three years of ticket data sitting in two systems and nobody trusts it. Is it good enough to fine-tune on?
Legal is asking whether this system falls under the EU AI Act. Do we need a conformity assessment before we ship?
Where exactly does a human stay in the loop once the agent drafts the reply that goes to the customer?
We are running four workstreams and the integration one is two sprints behind. How do I get the delivery plan back on track?
Should we standardise on one model provider or keep the abstraction layer? The architecture review is Thursday.
Our executive sponsor has changed for the second time and the steering committee has lost the plot. How do we re-establish sponsorship?
The target operating model has the agent doing triage. Who decides the new role boundaries and the process redesign that goes with it?
Adoption stalled at about a third of licensed users six months in. Half the team quietly went back to the old way of working.
Nobody has cleaned the CRM in years and half the fields are free text. Can we still train a model on this?
router.note: holdout miss, recorded rather than fixed. The client says 'train a model on this'; the vocabulary derived from t04 says 'fine-tune' and 'training data'. Adding 'train a model' after seeing this case would be copying words between two files, not routing on unseen language, so the miss stands as the measurement.

router.task: The steering committee wants one view of benefits realization across the five use cases before the next funding round.
Map the target state for order-to-cash and show me where the handoffs between people and agents actually sit.
Does the screening model need a bias audit before it goes live, and who signs off on that?
